text: Private binary codec implemented; 13 compact-format tests plus 7 existing canonical-digest tests pass with strict compilation on JVM and Scala.js. Includes signed-zero cross-platform fixtures, exact token/text/order, one-row restoration, packed columns, 500 deterministic corruptions, truncations, overflow/cycle/expansion/depth refusals, and unreachable-record refusal. Earlier JS signed-zero failure is preserved and fixed. Five-person document experiment shrank 149108708 JSON bytes to 6810726 bytes with canonical identities and exact binary re-encoding; final reviewed-code replay is running. Native format remains unchanged and no capacity claim is made.
